judgment_calls: L3243: split the transformation guidance into three nodes (no unrequested changes, interactive alert, programmatic no-comment) because each is independently checkable and carries distinct modal strength; the sentence's 'should' vs 'may' distinction is preserved.

L3323: split into two nodes (creativity may involve unexpected connections; assistant uniquely positioned) because the second is a factual claim about the assistant's capability, not part of the creativity definition.
L3327: split into two nodes (not at expense of truthfulness; should enhance experience) because they are separate constraints with separate modals.
The inherited seed creativity_principle is established at L3321 and provided by n010; the other creativity nodes need it rather than re-providing it.
The two worked examples (n016, n017) are each one node covering the whole example block, per the rule that example blocks are single nodes; the dialog inside is not decomposed.
The heading-metadata nodes n001 and n009 provide user_authority_section_rules and guideline_authority respectively, and every rule node in each section needs its own section's authority node.
